segments.name: Pharmaceutical Therapies
segments.description: Develops and commercializes therapies for patients with chronic and life-threatening conditions, chiefly pulmonary arterial hypertension and related rare diseases.
segments.evidence: Our operating segment focuses on the development and commercialization of products to address the unmet needs of patients with chronic and life-threatening conditions.

revenueModel.text: Specialty pharmaceutical distributors and international distributors pay us for our commercial therapies, and revenue is recognized when control of the product transfers to them.
revenueModel.evidence: We recognize revenue when we transfer control of our product to our distributors, which is generally when the product is shipped or delivered to the distributor.
